Online store builder for Indian businesses

CartWhizz is an online store builder for India. You sign up, pick a theme, add your products and start selling, with GST invoices, UPI, cash on delivery and Indian couriers already set up to use. Hosting, every theme and CartWhizz AI are included, and plans start at ₹249 a month after a 7-day free trial.

How it works

  1. Create your store. Sign up with your email, choose a store name and pick a theme. Your store gets its own address straight away, and you can connect your own domain later.
  2. Add your products. Type them in, take photos with your phone, or import a spreadsheet (CSV or Excel). CartWhizz AI can write product descriptions for you.
  3. Turn on payments and shipping, then go live. Connect your payment gateway, choose your delivery options and follow the launch checklist.

Built for how India sells

GST, done for you. Add HSN codes to products and CartWhizz charges CGST and SGST or IGST based on the delivery address, then puts your GSTIN on every invoice. See the India GST guide and the GST basics for online sellers.

UPI, cards and cash on delivery. Take UPI and card payments through Razorpay or PayU (Razorpay setup, PayU setup), and offer cash on delivery with the controls that stop it eating your margin (read how).

Indian couriers. Connect Shiprocket to compare courier rates and print labels, or set your own flat and free-shipping rules. Local businesses can limit delivery to their area with Hyperlocal delivery.

Rupee pricing, no surprise fees. Plans are priced in rupees and there is no platform fee on payments below your plan's monthly sales limit.

Everything in one place

  • Orders, stock and customers in one admin, on desktop or phone.
  • A shop counter (POS) for your physical shop, sharing the same stock and customers.
  • Marketing tools: coupons, abandoned-cart reminders, reviews and reward points.
  • CartWhizz AI for your shoppers and in your admin, included on every plan.
  • Staff accounts with their own permissions.

See the full feature list.

From Instagram and WhatsApp to your own store

Many Indian sellers start by taking orders in DMs and chats. A store of your own gives every product a permanent link you can share, takes payment before you pack, and keeps every order, customer and invoice in one place instead of scattered across chats. You can keep selling on social media and send buyers to your store to check out, and order updates can reach customers by email or WhatsApp. Read how CartWhizz works for a walk-through of a first order.

Plans

PlanMonthly feeCommission-free sales each monthCommission above that
Starter₹249₹25,0002%
Growth₹799₹1,00,0001.5%
Pro₹3,499₹5,00,0001%
Enterprise₹29,999₹50,00,0000.5%

Prices are before GST and billed monthly. Full details and a cost calculator are on the pricing page.

Who it is for

Clothing and jewellery brands, grocery and bakery stores, electronics and auto-parts sellers, pharmacies and gift shops, and anyone moving from social-media selling to their own store. The themes are built for these kinds of shops.

Frequently asked questions

Do I need a developer? No. Everything from theme to payments is set up from the admin, and the store guide walks you through each step.

Can I sell on my own domain? Yes, on supported plans. You can start on your free store address and connect a domain whenever you are ready.

Is there a free plan? There is no free plan, but every plan starts with a 7-day free trial so you can build your store before paying.

Where is support based? In India. Reach the team by email or WhatsApp from the contact page.
